```python
# Generic example: find the most-played song in the user's saved-song library.
access_token = apis.spotify.login(
    username=main_user.username,
    password=passwords['spotify']
)

song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(
        access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index
    )
    if not page.songs:
        break
    song_ids.update(s.song_id for s in page.songs)
    page_index += 1

songs = [apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid) for sid in song_ids]
target = max(songs, key=lambda s: s.play_count)
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=target.title, status="success")
```
